machines.name: iMac (2019)
machines.job: The heaviest lab workloads. An i9 and 64 GB of RAM, running Proxmox.

principles.title: Nothing exposed
principles.text: No port forwards. Published apps go out through an outbound-only tunnel, behind an identity check that happens before traffic reaches the lab.

principles.title: One job per credential
principles.text: Keys per device, TOTP on every admin interface, read-only tokens for anything that only needs to look.

principles.title: Off when idle
principles.text: Three standalone Proxmox nodes instead of a cluster, so the machines that heat the room only run when I need them.
